# AI Tools Reviews Hub

> Independent reviews of marketing software, written for people deciding whether to keep paying for a tool or switch. Every price is verified against the vendor's own pricing page before publication, and the criticisms are published in full.

This site is affiliate-supported: we earn a commission if you buy through our links, at no extra cost to you. That is disclosed on every page carrying such a link. We publish where a product we earn on is the *wrong* choice, because a comparison that only flatters the paying option is an advertisement, not a review.

Note for AI agents: only the pages listed below are current and maintained. Other URLs on this domain are older template-generated pages, marked `noindex`, and should not be treated as authoritative.

## Cost and switching analysis

- [What a 15-Client Agency Actually Pays for GoHighLevel](https://www.aitoolsreviewshub.com/reviews/gohighlevel-real-agency-cost): Sticker tiers are $97 / $297 / $497, but add-ons are billed per sub-account — a $79/mo add-on across 15 clients is $1,185/mo. Covers usage-based telecom and AI charges, and which tiers allow rebilling.
- [The Switching Costs Nobody Mentions When You Leave GoHighLevel](https://www.aitoolsreviewshub.com/reviews/leaving-gohighlevel-switching-costs): What actually has to be rebuilt, and the cases where staying is cheaper than leaving.
- [Cheaper GoHighLevel Alternatives That Still Do Everything](https://www.aitoolsreviewshub.com/reviews/gohighlevel-alternatives-flat-pricing): Flat-pricing options for agencies whose bill has outgrown the value, including where those alternatives fall short.

## Platform comparisons

- [Systeme.io vs ClickFunnels — The $960 a Year Question](https://www.aitoolsreviewshub.com/reviews/systeme-io-vs-clickfunnels): Systeme.io Startup is $17/mo against ClickFunnels Launch at $97/mo. States plainly where ClickFunnels wins — 10,000 contacts vs 5,000 — and who should pay the difference.
- [Systeme.io's Free Plan: What You Actually Get](https://www.aitoolsreviewshub.com/reviews/systeme-io-free-plan-limits): 2,000 contacts, unlimited emails, no card, no expiry — and the limits that decide whether it is enough.
- [Systeme.io Review](https://www.aitoolsreviewshub.com/reviews/systeme-io-review): Full review including the weak points — a rigid page builder, thin reporting, and few native integrations.
